R1.description: an item folder that cannot be opened is a named outcome everywhere: the report records it as unreadable (an incomplete report, exit 0), the walkers behind _scan, the pack and _hash_folder refuse unreadable or folder_changed, and _remove_tree stops with remove_failed or folder_changed and its deleted count; the first open of os.fwalk was outside its onerror (#119 item 1 similar calls, #149 item 5); tests T1 to T4 (an ENOENT at the report's top open reads as no review folder), mutations m1 to m4

R2.description: the lock-time recheck of remove (_flow step 1) reports a swapped archive directory and a leftover that appeared or vanished as folder_changed, with its next step run it again, nothing moved or deleted (#119 item 3); test T5, mutations m5 and m6

R3.description: _review_folder never names a directory the walk did not fail on after a same-name collision: pending entries carry a silent flag for a link whose probe opened, no retry or re-probe is read as proof a link was passed, and a failure that a silent link could explain is recorded on the review folder's own path (only the silent entry is popped; the nearest real same-name sibling is kept in place and flagged ambiguous, so the stack mirrors the walk), while every existing layout keeps its result but one amended tuple (#149 item 2); test T6, mutations m7 to m9 (T6 a to e)

R4.description: an OSError no site maps ends archive, remove and prune as unreadable (exit 2, the command's next step) through one backstop, and the report's own os.close is best effort (#119 item 1 similar calls, #143 item 4); the remove message states only verified facts (the folder may be in .removing, unverified against the archive); tests T7 (one per decorator), T8 and T9, mutations m10 to m12

R5.description: every path that works today stays byte-identical (the 97 existing retention tests green, one tuple amended, a before and after driver over the working paths), no new refusal code, each fix proved by a test that fails without it, docs/RETENTION.md and docs/exit-codes.md name the new outcomes, roadmap row 44 is Current, no page names an internal milestone id, the installation is untouched
